title: Tarjuma-yi Aḥādīs-i Mamzūj bā Sukhanān-i ʿAlī u Aʾimma
transliterated_title: Tarjuma-yi Aḥādīs-i Mamzūj bā Sukhanān-i ʿAlī u Aʾimma (Translation of the Hadiths of ʿAlī and the Imams; variants Tarjuma-yi Aḥādīs az Amīr al-Muʾminīn, Sharḥ al-Nahj)
genre: translation and exposition of hadiths of ʿAlī and the Imams

date.basis: The only copy (MS Majlis 10196) is undated and incomplete, with a defaced title.

manuscript: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 440b-41b (the only known copy; undated, incomplete, title seemingly defaced).
majlis_folios: ff. 440b-41b (beyond the 425 ff. the dissertation elsewhere gives for the manuscript)
summary: An exposition of hadiths of ʿAlī and the other Imams, known from one truncated copy with a defaced title.
